gloss: dry rainy season; rainy season with little rain

definitions.gloss: dry rainy season; rainy season with little rain
definitions.explanation: A tsuyu (rainy season) in which far less rain falls than usual, sometimes causing water shortages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空梅雨|からつゆ}だ。
examples.english: This year the rainy season is dry.

examples.japanese: {空梅雨|からつゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{水不足|みずぶそく}→水不足：15397_mizubusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: With the dry rainy season, water shortages are a concern.

examples.japanese: {空梅雨|からつゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{農作物|のうさくもつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生育|せいいく}→生育：22487_seiiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A prolonged dry rainy season affects the growth of crops.

notes:
The prefix ⟦{空|から}→空：27640_kara⟧- means 'empty' — the rainy season arrives but brings little rain. Read からつゆ, not くうばいう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空梅雨|からつゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn into a dry rainy season
- {空梅雨|からつゆ}⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧: somewhat short of rain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧: the rainy season — June through July in most of Japan
- ⟦{梅雨明|つゆあ}け→梅雨明け：08338_tsuyuake⟧: the end of the rainy season
